mapper.select: SELECT r.RULE_ID, r.DM_ID, dm.DM_NM AS DATA_MODEL_NM, r.OBJ_NM, r.ATTR_NM, r.DOMAIN_ID, d.DOMAIN_NM, r.RULE_NM, r.RULE_TYPE, r.RULE_PARAMS, r.SEVERITY, r.USE_YN, r.INCREMENTAL_COL, r.EST_COST, r.DESCR, r.CRET_USER_ID, r.CRET_DT, r.UPDT_USER_ID, r.UPDT_DT FROM TB_QUAL_RULE r LEFT JOIN TB_DATA_MODEL dm ON dm.DM_ID = r.DM_ID LEFT JOIN TB_DOMAIN d ON d.DOMAIN_ID = r.DOMAIN_ID WHERE 1=1 AND r.DM_ID = #{dmId} AND r.OBJ_NM = #{objNm} AND r.USE_YN = #{useYn} ORDER BY r.UPDT_DT DESC NULLS LAST, r.CRET_DT DESC
SELECT r.*, dm.DM_NM AS DATA_MODEL_NM, d.DOMAIN_NM FROM TB_QUAL_RULE r LEFT JOIN TB_DATA_MODEL dm ON dm.DM_ID = r.DM_ID LEFT JOIN TB_DOMAIN d ON d.DOMAIN_ID = r.DOMAIN_ID WHERE r.RULE_ID = #{ruleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_QUAL_RULE ( RULE_ID, DM_ID, OBJ_NM, ATTR_NM, DOMAIN_ID, RULE_NM, RULE_TYPE, RULE_PARAMS, SEVERITY, USE_YN, INCREMENTAL_COL, EST_COST, DESCR, CRET_USER_ID, CRET_DT ) VALUES ( #{ruleId}, #{dmId}, #{objNm}, #{attrNm}, #{domainId}, #{ruleNm}, #{ruleType}, #{ruleParams}, COALESCE(#{severity}, 'WARN'), COALESCE(#{useYn}, 'Y'), #{incrementalCol}, #{estCost}, #{descr}, #{cretUserId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_QUAL_RULE SET OBJ_NM = #{objNm}, ATTR_NM = #{attrNm}, DOMAIN_ID = #{domainId}, RULE_NM = #{ruleNm}, RULE_TYPE = #{ruleType}, RULE_PARAMS = #{ruleParams}, SEVERITY = #{severity}, USE_YN = #{useYn}, INCREMENTAL_COL = #{incrementalCol}, EST_COST = #{estCost}, DESCR = #{descr}, UPDT_USER_ID = #{updtUserId}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE RULE_ID = #{ruleId}
mapper.select: SELECT CATALOG_ID AS catalogId, CATALOG_NM AS catalogNm, RULE_TYPE AS ruleType, RULE_PARAMS AS ruleParams, CATEGORY AS category, DESCR AS descr, USE_YN AS useYn FROM TB_QUAL_RULE_CATALOG WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY CATEGORY, CATALOG_NM
